allow_access_changed.title: Apple TV AirPlay access changed ({tv})
allow_access_changed.description: On the Apple TV, open Settings → AirPlay and HomeKit → Allow Access. Restore the setting that allows the Home Assistant host to connect, then run the bridge self-test.

pairing_removed.title: Apple TV pairing was removed ({tv})
pairing_removed.description: Open Settings → Devices & services and reauthenticate Apple TV Agent Bridge. Enter the new PIN shown on the TV.

unreachable.title: Apple TV bridge cannot connect ({tv})
unreachable.description: Check that the bridge app is running and on the same network as the Apple TV. Wake the TV, check apple_tv_host if set, then run the bridge self-test.

screen_pairing_invalid.title: Apple TV screen pairing needs repair ({tv})
screen_pairing_invalid.description: On the Apple TV, open Settings → Remotes and Devices → Remote App and Devices. In Home Assistant, open the bridge integration, select Configure → Re-pair screen, and enter the new six-digit PIN.
